results.title: Entre as cinzas
results.overview: In Brazil, arson is the leading cause of deforestation and land grabbing. Alex Gomes, leader of a volunteer fire brigade, battles grueling and dangerous fires in an effort to save his community and the environment.

results.title: Made in Bali
results.overview: A young man from a family of Balinese puppeteers must choose between a sensible arranged marriage or take a chance with his childhood best friend.

results.title: The Boy and the Dog
results.overview: 6 months after the earthquake disaster in Sendai City, Nakagaki Kazumasa is a young man who has lost his job. He encounters a dog named Tamon on its dog tag, who lost its owner in the earthquake disaster. Kazumasa decides to take Tamon in, and the dog becomes attached to him and his family, but Tamon always seems concerned about something in the south direction.  One day, while Kazumasa is involved in a dangerous incident, Tamon disappears. Later, in Shiga, Tamon is with Sugai Miwa, who has a sad secret. Kazumasa reunites with Tamon, and they start a new life together. Nevertheless, Tamon heads south because Tamon has a promise it wants to keep to a boy.

results.title: High Infidelity
results.overview: Larissa finds out her husband is cheating on her with her colleague. She does the unexpected, forgives her husband and decides to team up with him to outsmart the colleague who's trying to destroy their marriage. But not everything is as it appears.

results.title: Manolo
results.overview: Under the blazing sun of the Lazio coastline, Manolo and Elia chase the illusion of a heist that could change their lives. Manolo’s journey toward himself winds through the shadows of a forest, where an unexpected encounter confronts him with his own destiny.

results.title: Zora
results.overview: A cop pursues his father's killer after 20 years, guided by a perfume bottle marked "Scent By The Devil." His quest for vengeance uncovers hidden truths.

results.title: And Then We'll See
results.overview: Three houses, three boys, the same goal: to win the competition for a position as an employee in the legal office of the city. Federico, a law graduate, but only to please his father counsellor, hopes for his recommendation; Fabrizio, lawyer on paper but not practicing in life, tries to overcome the umpteenth public test and Luca, who since he was born has always had the road open. Only for one of them will the dream of a lifetime come true, until things take an unexpected turn.

results.title: Marigold First Dream 2025
results.overview: Marigold First Dream 2025 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Dream Star★Fighting Marigold. It took place on January 3, 2025, at Ota City General Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan, and was main evented by Sareee defending the Marigold World Championship against Utami Hayashishita.

results.title: Hold me tighter than anyone else
results.original_title: 誰よりもつよく抱きしめて
results.overview: Tsukina and Ryouki have been dating since their teenage years. Unfortunately Ryouki has developed a obsession with cleanliness that has left him unable to even touch Tsukina. Eventually agreeing to start therapy for his condition, Ryouki meets Chiharu, a young woman suffering from the same issue as himself, and begins to form a connection. At the same time Tsukina meets a handsome Korean man who shows an interest in her.

results.title: Night Watches Us
results.overview: In August 2018, a 23-year-old Black father was shot and killed by Montreal police while grappling with a mental crisis. Through a poetic blend of music, dance and spoken word, his family’s desire for justice is brought to life.
